description: Patterns and assumptions agents must refuse for Platform 3.0 ticket serverless handlers

refusals.forbidden_assumption: If data.changes.model_changes is missing or empty, infer that only status or priority changed by comparing undocumented keys on data.ticket, or map Freshdesk priority semantics to Freshservice urgency without API verification.
refusals.required_behavior: Load references/events/onTicketUpdate-payload-contract.md. If deltas are required and absent, use snapshot/API diff, broad handling with documented caveats, skip, or state Insufficient platform certainty — do not guess.
